# Calm Joints

> Calm Joints (Calm Joints Inc.) is a virtual physiotherapy service in Canada. People book registered physiotherapists online. Channel partners connect any calendar — app, site, or scheduler — to Scale's Canada-wide booking engine for physio bookings: virtual care or in-person treatment at trusted locations. Canada-wide now. USA launching Q1 2027. Partners share the profit.

## Enterprise: one click to physio
- [Any calendar. One click to physio.](https://calmjoints.org/enterprise): Connect your app, site or scheduler to Scale's Canada-wide booking engine. Virtual care or in-person treatment at trusted locations. We run physio bookings. You share the profit. Optional turnkey co-branded store.
- Contact: info@calmjoints.org or the form at https://calmjoints.org/enterprise#talk

## For people
- [Home](https://calmjoints.org/): Book virtual physio with a registered physiotherapist.
- [Talk to a guide](https://calmjoints.org/chat): Virtual recovery guides (not clinicians).
- [Blog](https://calmjoints.org/blog): Recovery articles.

## Partners
- [Partnerships](https://calmjoints.org/partners): Hubs and partnerships for gyms, studios, brands, employers and clinics.
- [Careers](https://calmjoints.org/careers): Roles for physiotherapists.

## Notes
- Calm Joints is not a medical device and not emergency care. In an emergency, call 911.
